svg.text: Stereo Model with Thin Inclined Parallel Plate
For parallel faces and the same exterior medium, the emergent ray is parallel to the incident ray.
The plate makes the pixel → 3D line mapping effectively non-central and pixel-dependent.
The effective stereo baseline becomes ray-dependent in the plate model.
A thin inclined plane-parallel plate preserves the exterior ray direction but introduces a lateral shift.
This turns the central pinhole model into a pixel-dependent effective ray-origin model for each channel.
